id: title:dmarchuk:move a new broadcast onto its own url once its draft is saved

review.posthog_relevance: Preservation of broadcast campaign draft state and recovery from transient errors or navigation, preventing loss of user work.
review.reason: The implementation hunks P1.F2.H7 and P1.F2.H10 introduce a saved draft URL redirect and state preservation mechanism. This allows users to retain their broadcast campaign configuration after a save, launch failure, or email change warning, rather than losing the draft or being redirected away. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and user experience.
review.uncertainty: The exact implementation details and test coverage are not fully visible, and the benefit is inferred from the presence of the redirect action rather than demonstrated recovery behavior. No production incident or adoption data is available.
